assumptions: HXI globally serializes requests; the contract permits one outstanding transaction.
Code and data memory are each 64 KiB with synchronous response behavior.
The demo core is verification infrastructure and is not the user's final CPU implementation.
The prior project supplies board pin facts only; old SoC RTL is not reused.
